confidence_notes: Crowdsourced prices inform the meal, cappuccino and draft beer estimates. [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Penang) Cocktail and wine prices are less certain and reflect typical local premiums over draft beer. [Penang price guide](https://www.visitpenang.com/food/price-guide) [Restaurant wine list](https://firegroup.my/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Firewood-Penang-Full-Menu-March-2026.pdf) Lodging estimates are modeled for typical July nights and vary by neighborhood and weekend demand.
comparable_city_reasoning: George Town serves as the urban reference for Penang. Melaka and Ipoh provide context for budget lodging, with an allowance for tourism demand in George Town's heritage district.
